title: ICC Plus rules phase operation script
description: Gameplay rules phase. Runtime accepts rule entities and mechanical fields; section text/layout and styling fields are rejected. The same add/update/delete operations accept one or many targets; there are no separate bulk phase commands.

oneOf.description: One-or-many phase edit. Use values for one entity or items for many entities of the same kind and parent.
One-or-many phase edit. Use values for one entity or items for many entities of the same kind and parent.
One-or-many phase edit. Target one ref, an explicit refs list, or a selector with optional expect bounds.
Apply one compact ChoiceFunc effect object to one or many Choices/selectable Addons.
One-or-many phase delete. Target one ref, an explicit refs list, or a selector with optional expect bounds.

selector.description: Exact structural selector used by bulk operations. title_contains and text_contains are literal case-insensitive substring filters, not fuzzy matching.

effects.description: Script-friendly ChoiceFunc effects. The CLI expands these into ordinary native ICC Plus fields and rejects conflicts with explicitly supplied native fields.
